words.sense: Take something for one’s own use without permission, or officially set resources aside for a specified use.
misconceptions: Missing an authorised allocation of funds as an appropriate use.
Confusing a public compulsory transfer with personal unauthorised taking.

words.sense: Officially take private property from its owner, typically by government authority for public use.
misconceptions: Calling any taking of property an official dispossession.
Confusing a public compulsory transfer with personal unauthorised taking.

semantic_axes.description: Appropriate means take or allocate for use; expropriate specifically means an authority formally takes private property from its owner.
